name: pincher-curl
description: DEPRECATED — kept for comparison with the five manual rounds only. Drives pincher through curl against the REST surface (http://127.0.0.1:7878/v1/<tool>) instead of MCP. Pays a harness tax (JSON quoting, curl boilerplate, full envelopes in Bash output) that real MCP integration does not; this arm exists to quantify that tax, not to represent pincher.
